literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 本研究从人类病例中鉴定出一种新型重组猴痘病毒,属于Ib/IIb系谱,具有来自两个系谱的特定遗传序列。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2760649]

总体而言,77.06%的参与者表示愿意参与猴痘一线工作,18.57%表示犹豫,4.37%表示拒绝。在参与者特征中,因他人建议而选择学医与更高的犹豫(比值比(OR)=1.425;95%置信区间(CI)=1.142-1.776)和拒绝(OR=1.635;95% CI=1.110-2.407)相关。更高的猴痘知识水平(OR=0.973;95% CI=0.966-0.981)和更高的疫苗接种相关行为得分(OR=0.894;95% CI=0.882-0.907)与较低的犹豫意愿相关。更高的疫苗接种相关行为得分也与较低的拒绝意愿相关(OR=0.883;95% CI=0.862-0.904)。 [10.7189/jogh.16.04327]
第三代非复制型疫苗(MVA-BN/JYNNEOS/Imvanex/IMVAMUNE)因其良好的安全性,被一致推荐用于孕妇和儿童。主要主题包括免疫接种策略、预防措施、效果、障碍和促进因素。 [10.1371/journal.pgph.0007583]
出现了三个主题:从以往暴发中积累的制度记忆和现有基础设施、结构性和社会性障碍,以及社区的适应性反应。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11222933/v1]
基因组数据揭示了多达八次独立的病毒引入事件,涉及B.1、B.1.2和B.1.6谱系,这些事件与来自巴西、阿根廷和智利的旅行有关,而本地传播传播链则较短且地理上受限。 [10.1186/s12985-026-03342-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The study identified a novel recombinant monkeypox virus from human cases, belonging to clade Ib/IIb, with specific genetic sequences from both clades. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2760649]
Overall, 77.06% were willing to perform frontline mpox work, 18.57% were hesitant, and 4.37% refused. [10.7189/jogh.16.04327]

Third-generation non-replicating vaccines (MVA-BN/JYNNEOS/Imvanex/IMVAMUNE) were consistently recommended for pregnant women and children because of their favourable safety profiles. Key themes included immunisation strategies, preventive measures, effectiveness, barriers, and facilitators. [10.1371/journal.pgph.0007583]
Three themes emerged: institutional memory and pre-existing infrastructure from prior outbreaks, structural and social barriers, and adaptive community responses. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11222933/v1]

Genomic data revealed up to eight independent viral introductions involving lineages B.1, B.1.2, and B.1.6, linked to travel from Brazil, Argentina, and Chile, with local transmission chains remaining short and geographically restricted. [10.1186/s12985-026-03342-8]

papers.title: Epidemiological and Clinical Features of Clade Ib Mpox Virus Infection in African Countries and Non-Endemic Contexts: A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Mpox virus (MPXV) Clade I has historically been confined to sporadic zoonotic outbreaks in Central Africa. In 2023, a novel Clade I lineage (designated Clade Ib) emerged, exhibiting sustained human-to-human transmission. Emerging evidence suggests that the epidemiological and clinical profile of Clade Ib differs between endemic African settings and non-endemic contexts, with implications for surveillance, diagnosis, and clinical management. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on this divergence, drawing on 54 eligible studies identified through targeted PubMed searches supplemented by institutional surveillance sources covering September 2023 to 16 August 2026. Age and sex distribution and route of transmission vary widely and dynamically across African outbreaks, whereas non-African cases remain almost uniformly adult and linked to sexual networks among men who have sex with men (MSM), with anogenital disease and proctitis increasingly reported over time. Case burden remains higher in Africa, and case-fatality estimates are markedly lower than those of Clade Ia. However, several differences, including those in hospitalization and mortality, are confounded by different case identification methods between hospital-based African cohorts and population-based non-African surveillance, and data on pregnancy, pediatric disease, and infection in immunocompromised patients remain almost entirely absent outside Africa.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review examines the epidemiological and clinical features of Clade Ib Mpox virus infection in African countries and non-endemic contexts. It highlights the emergence of Clade Ib in 2023, which has shown sustained human-to-human transmission. The review identifies differences in age and sex distribution, transmission routes, and clinical manifestations between African and non-African settings, with non-African cases predominantly affecting adults linked to sexual networks among men who have sex with men (MSM). The findings suggest the need for enhanced surveillance, diagnosis, and clinical management strategies in non-endemic regions, as well as further research to address these evidence gaps.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于非洲国家及非流行区中Clade Ib 猴痘病毒感染的流行病学和临床特征。核心问题是理解Clade Ib在流行区和非流行区之间的流行病学和临床特征差异,以及其对传播、诊断和临床管理的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是基于通过有针对性的PubMed搜索以及覆盖2023年9月至2026年8月16日的机构监测来源确定的54项合格研究的叙述性综合。证据来源于描述2023年新型Clade Ib分支出现的研究,该分支表现出持续的人传人传播。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 新兴证据表明,Clade Ib在非洲和非非洲环境中的流行病学和临床特征存在差异。非非洲病例几乎全部为成年人,且与男同性恋者(MSM)的性网络传播相关,随着时间推移,肛周疾病和直肠炎的报告逐渐增加。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 包括住院和死亡率在内的多个差异可能受到非洲医院系统与非非洲人口系统之间不同的病例识别方法的影响。关于妊娠、儿童疾病以及免疫功能低下患者感染的数据在非洲以外几乎完全缺失。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本综述强调了在非流行区中需要改善Clade Ib 猴痘病毒感染的传播、诊断和临床管理。同时,它也突出了进一步研究Clade Ib在不同人群(包括孕妇、儿童和免疫功能低下者)中的流行病学和临床特征的重要性。

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)Clade I历史上一直局限于中非地区的偶发人兽共患病。2023年,一种新型Clade I分支(称为Clade Ib)出现,表现出持续的人传人传播。新兴证据表明,Clade Ib的流行病学和临床特征在非洲流行区和非流行区之间存在差异,这对其传播、诊断和临床管理具有影响。本叙述性综述综合了当前关于这种差异的证据,基于通过有针对性的PubMed搜索确定的54项合格研究,以及覆盖2023年9月至2026年8月16日的机构监测来源。非洲暴发中的年龄和性别分布以及传播途径差异显著且动态变化,而非非洲病例几乎全部为成年人,且与男同性恋者(MSM)的性网络传播相关,随着时间推移,肛周疾病和直肠炎的报告逐渐增加。病例负担在非洲仍较高,病例死亡率估计明显低于Clade Ia。然而,包括住院和死亡率在内的多个差异可能受到非洲医院系统与非非洲人口系统之间不同的病例识别方法的影响,且关于妊娠、儿童疾病以及免疫功能低下患者感染的数据在非洲以外几乎完全缺失。
papers.summary_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)Clade I历史上一直局限于中非地区的偶发人兽共患病。2023年,一种新型Clade I分支(称为Clade Ib)出现,表现出持续的人传人传播。新兴证据表明,Clade Ib的流行病学和临床特征在非洲流行区和非流行区之间存在差异,这对其传播、诊断和临床管理具有影响。本叙述性综述综合了当前关于这种差异的证据,基于通过有针对性的PubMed搜索确定的54项合格研究,以及覆盖2023年9月至2026年8月16日的机构监测来源。非洲暴发中的年龄和性别分布以及传播途径差异显著且动态变化,而非非洲病例几乎全部为成年人,且与男同性恋者(MSM)的性网络传播相关,随着时间推移,肛周疾病和直肠炎的报告逐渐增加。病例负担在非洲仍较高,病例死亡率估计明显低于Clade Ia。然而,包括住院和死亡率在内的多个差异可能受到非洲医院系统与非非洲人口系统之间不同的病例识别方法的影响,且关于妊娠、儿童疾病以及免疫功能低下患者感染的数据在非洲以外几乎完全缺失。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于非洲国家及非流行区中Clade Ib 猴痘病毒感染的流行病学和临床特征。核心问题是理解Clade Ib在流行区和非流行区之间的流行病学和临床特征差异,以及其对传播、诊断和临床管理的影响。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是基于通过有针对性的PubMed搜索以及覆盖2023年9月至2026年8月16日的机构监测来源确定的54项合格研究的叙述性综合。证据来源于描述2023年新型Clade Ib分支出现的研究,该分支表现出持续的人传人传播。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 新兴证据表明,Clade Ib在非洲和非非洲环境中的流行病学和临床特征存在差异。非非洲病例几乎全部为成年人,且与男同性恋者(MSM)的性网络传播相关,随着时间推移,肛周疾病和直肠炎的报告逐渐增加。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 包括住院和死亡率在内的多个差异可能受到非洲医院系统与非非洲人口系统之间不同的病例识别方法的影响。关于妊娠、儿童疾病以及免疫功能低下患者感染的数据在非洲以外几乎完全缺失。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本综述强调了在非流行区中需要改善Clade Ib 猴痘病毒感染的传播、诊断和临床管理。同时,它也突出了进一步研究Clade Ib在不同人群(包括孕妇、儿童和免疫功能低下者)中的流行病学和临床特征的重要性。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved a retrospective analysis of monkeypox virus samples from human cases, focusing on clade Ib and IIb recombinants.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers used molecular sequencing and phylogenetic analysis to identify and characterize the recombinant monkeypox virus.
analysis_en.main_results: The study identified a novel recombinant monkeypox virus from human cases, belonging to clade Ib/IIb, with specific genetic sequences from both clades.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as novel evidence of interclade recombinants, which could have implications for the epidemiology and evolution of monkeypox virus.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could inform surveillance and understanding of the genetic diversity and potential public health risks associated with monkeypox virus.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's retrospective nature and limited sample size may limit the generalizability of the findings, but the evidence is considered high.

papers.title: Willingness of Chinese medical students to work on the frontline during a potential mpox outbreak: a nationwide cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The global mpox epidemic has been designated a public health emergency of international concern, placing substantial strain on public health systems worldwide. As a critical reserve workforce for outbreak response, medical students' willingness to serve on monkeypox (mpox) frontlines remains understudied, and evidence on their mpox-related knowledge, attitudes, and practices and their association with frontline work willingness is still limited. METHODS: We conducted an online nationwide cross-sectional survey among Chinese medical students from November 2023 to March 2024 using snowball sampling. We used multinomial logistic regression to identify independent influencing factors. RESULTS: We included a total of 4,098 participants. Overall, 77.06% were willing to perform frontline mpox work, 18.57% were hesitant, and 4.37% refused. Among participant characteristics, studying medicine at others' suggestion was associated with both higher hesitancy (odds ratio (OR) = 1.425; 95% confidence interval (CI) = 1.142-1.776) and refusal (OR = 1.635; 95% CI = 1.110-2.407). Greater mpox knowledge (OR = 0.973; 95% CI = 0.966-0.981) and higher vaccination-related behaviour scores (OR = 0.894; 95% CI = 0.882-0.907) were associated with lower hesitancy to work on the mpox frontline. Higher vaccination-related behaviour scores were also associated with lower refusal (OR = 0.883; 95% CI = 0.862-0.904). CONCLUSIONS: Most Chinese medical students demonstrated favourable willingness to support frontline mpox response. Medical education should strengthen training in mpox prevention and professional ethics. Public health policies should use risk-stratified deployment, provide adequate protection and psychological support, and establish targeted mobilisation mechanisms to improve the emergency response capacity of the medical student reserve workforce.

papers.title: Immunisation and preventive measures against mpox in pregnant women and children: A scoping review.
papers.abstract: Mpox (monkeypox) poses disproportionate risks to pregnant women and children, yet evidence on immunisation and prevention in these groups remains limited. This scoping review mapped and synthesised existing evidence on vaccines and non-pharmaceutical preventive measures for mpox in pregnant women and children, to assess reported effectiveness, and to identify implementation barriers and facilitators. Peer-reviewed and Grey literature were searched in PubMed, Scopus, and Google for records published since 2008; databases were last searched on 19 September 2025. Screening and data extraction followed a pre-specified protocol and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) framework. Key themes included immunisation strategies, preventive measures, effectiveness, barriers, and facilitators. Forty-eight peer-reviewed articles and 16 Grey literature sources were included. Third-generation non-replicating vaccines (MVA-BN/JYNNEOS/Imvanex/IMVAMUNE) were consistently recommended for pregnant women and children because of their favourable safety profiles. Observational and programmatic estimates of vaccine effectiveness (single dose 36-86%; two doses up to approximately 89%) came almost entirely from adults, and no effectiveness estimate specific to pregnant women or children was identified. No source reported vaccine use by trimester, and paediatric data were limited to small studies. Ring vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) were supported mainly by adult data. Major barriers included limited vaccine supply and cold-chain and logistical constraints in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), vaccine hesitancy driven by safety concerns, particularly in pregnancy, and the absence of randomised trials in pregnant women and children. Few sources were centred on Africa or other LMICs. Facilitators included international coordination, targeted surveillance, flexible delivery strategies such as intradermal dosing, and integration with maternal and child health services. Priorities include prospective safety and immunogenicity studies in pregnancy and childhood, equitable vaccine access in LMICs, and tailored risk communication to address hesitancy.

papers.title: Monkeypox Virus Seroprevalence among Adults Assessed at Roadside Wellness Centers along Major Transportation Corridor, Kenya, 2025
papers.abstract: Background: Since July 2024, Kenya has been experiencing its first monkeypox outbreak. Although over 1,000 cases have been confirmed, gaps in case‐based surveillance could lead to under-ascertainment. To better quantify unrecognized transmission, we conducted a monkeypox serosurvey at clinics along a high‐mobility transportation corridor in Kenya. Methods: We performed a cross-sectional serosurvey at eight clinics between 29 September to 28 October 2025. Adults ≥18 years completed a standardized questionnaire and provided blood samples tested using a multiplex‐bead serologic assay capable of distinguishing likely infection from orthopoxvirus vaccination. Seroprevalence was defined as the proportion of participants who tested seropositive out of all participants with valid test results. Associations with likely infection were assessed using modified Poisson regression with cluster‐robust standard errors. To assess under‐ascertainment, we compared the number of participants with serologic evidence of likely monkeypox infection to the number self‐reporting a prior laboratory‐confirmed monkeypox case. Findings: Of 2,896 participants with valid results, 332 (11.5%) were seropositive, including 82 (2.8%) classified as likely infection. Sex workers (6.4%) and truck drivers (4.1%) had the highest likely infection prevalence. Four participants reported prior confirmed monkeypox cases; all were seropositive. The ratio of persons with likely infections to previously confirmed cases was 21:1. Interpretation: These findings indicate under‐ascertainment of monkeypox infections in high‐risk communities in Kenya. Despite some evidence of undetected transmission, most participants lacked serological evidence of prior orthopoxvirus exposure indicating a potentially large susceptible population. These findings suggest diagnostic access, vaccination among high-risk groups, and ongoing serosurveillance may be important considerations for strengthening outbreak response.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess monkeypox virus seroprevalence among adults in Kenya, focusing on high-risk communities. A cross-sectional serosurvey was conducted at eight clinics along a major transportation corridor from September to October 2025. Participants provided blood samples tested with a multiplex-bead assay to differentiate between infection and vaccination. Of 2,896 participants, 11.5% were seropositive, with 2.8% classified as likely infection. Sex workers and truck drivers had the highest prevalence. Four participants reported prior confirmed cases, and all were seropositive, indicating a 21:1 ratio of likely infections to confirmed cases. The findings suggest under-ascertainment of infections and highlight the need for improved diagnostic access and vaccination strategies. The study provides valuable insights into the epidemiology of monkeypox in Kenya but does not report specific limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自2024年7月以来,肯尼亚经历了其首次猴痘暴发疫情。基于病例的监测存在缺口,可能导致病例漏报。

papers.title_zh: 肯尼亚主要交通走廊沿线路边健康中心评估的猴痘病毒血清流行率在成年人中的情况,2025年
papers.source_body_en: Background: Since July 2024, Kenya has been experiencing its first monkeypox outbreak. Although over 1,000 cases have been confirmed, gaps in case‐based surveillance could lead to under-ascertainment. To better quantify unrecognized transmission, we conducted a monkeypox serosurvey at clinics along a high‐mobility transportation corridor in Kenya. Methods: We performed a cross-sectional serosurvey at eight clinics between 29 September to 28 October 2025. Adults ≥18 years completed a standardized questionnaire and provided blood samples tested using a multiplex‐bead serologic assay capable of distinguishing likely infection from orthopoxvirus vaccination. Seroprevalence was defined as the proportion of participants who tested seropositive out of all participants with valid test results. Associations with likely infection were assessed using modified Poisson regression with cluster‐robust standard errors. To assess under‐ascertainment, we compared the number of participants with serologic evidence of likely monkeypox infection to the number self‐reporting a prior laboratory‐confirmed monkeypox case. Findings: Of 2,896 participants with valid results, 332 (11.5%) were seropositive, including 82 (2.8%) classified as likely infection. Sex workers (6.4%) and truck drivers (4.1%) had the highest likely infection prevalence. Four participants reported prior confirmed monkeypox cases; all were seropositive. The ratio of persons with likely infections to previously confirmed cases was 21:1. Interpretation: These findings indicate under‐ascertainment of monkeypox infections in high‐risk communities in Kenya. Despite some evidence of undetected transmission, most participants lacked serological evidence of prior orthopoxvirus exposure indicating a potentially large susceptible population. These findings suggest diagnostic access, vaccination among high-risk groups, and ongoing serosurveillance may be important considerations for strengthening outbreak response.

papers.title: Genomic insights into the mpox outbreak in Uruguay
papers.abstract: Uruguay reported a limited mpox outbreak during the 2022 global clade IIb epidemic, yet no genomic data from the country had been publicly available. Here, we generated and analyzed the first 17 monkeypox virus genomes from Uruguay, sampled during the 2022 outbreak and representing approximately 85% of the 20 confirmed national cases reported as of 2025. Phylogenetic inferences integrated with travel history and contact-tracing data identified evidence of up to eight independent viral introductions involving lineages B.1, B.1.2, and B.1.6, with events linked to travel from Brazil, Argentina, and Chile, while local transmission chains remained short and geographically restricted. These findings suggest that Uruguay’s small outbreak was driven not by fewer viral introductions, but by limited onward transmission. As the first genomic characterization of mpox in Uruguay, this study reinforces the importance of integrating genomic surveillance with epidemiological investigations during emerging outbreaks.

papers.abstract_zh: 乌拉圭在2022年全球IIb谱系疫情中报告了有限的猴痘 暴发病例,但该国尚未有公开的基因组数据。在此研究中,我们生成并分析了乌拉圭首次17例猴痘病毒基因组,这些样本采集于2022年暴发期间,代表了截至2025年报告的20例确认国内病例中的约85%。通过将系统发育推断与旅行史和接触追踪数据相结合,我们发现了涉及B.1、B.1.2和B.1.6谱系的多达八次独立病毒引入事件,这些事件与来自巴西、阿根廷和智利的旅行有关,而本地传播传播链则较短且地理上受限。这些发现表明,乌拉圭较小的暴发并非由于较少的病毒引入,而是由于有限的本地传播传播。作为乌拉圭首次对猴痘的基因组特征分析,本研究强调了在新兴暴发期间将基因组监测与流行病学调查相结合的重要性。

papers.title: Peer Review Report For: Psychometric properties of an instrument measuring monkeypox knowledge, perception, and beliefs of health threat in health science students in a middle-income country [version 3; peer review: 1 approved, 2 approved with reservations, 1 not approved]
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to establish the factor structure and reliability of the evaluation instrument measuring monkeypox (Mpox) knowledge, perception and beliefs of health threat in students of the health area in two universities of Peru during 2022. Methods The methodology used was psychometric in nature. The study variable on knowledge of Mpox was assessed using a 17-item questionnaire developed by Ricco et al., originally applied to health professionals, adapted to Peruvian context, and administered to 416 students. Results The results showed adequate goodness-of-fit indicators, with RMSEA and SRMR values below 0.08 and a TLI above 0.90, confirming an acceptable model fit. Reliability was adequate for knowledge of Mpox (KR20 = 0.70 and α = 0.73), with perception of health threats showing the highest reliability (α = 0.88 and Ω = 0.89). Conclusions The instrument demonstrated an adequate factor structure and acceptable reliability for measuring Mpox knowledge, perception, and health threat beliefs in Peruvian health students, supporting its applicability in future research and public health interventions.

papers.title: Genomic characteristics of the first five monkeypox virus clade Ib cases in Thailand: August 2024–March 2025
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Following the emergence of monkeypox virus clade Ib in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in August 2024, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern because of sustained transmission and international spread. We characterized the first clade Ib cases detected in Thailand between August 2024 and March 2025 and assessed their phylogenetic relationships. Whole-genome sequencing was performed from lesion swabs of suspected cases. Phylogenetic analysis, incorporating clade Ia ( DQ011155.1 ) and global clade Ib sequences from GISAID, confirmed all Thai isolates as clade Ib. The genomes showed close relatedness to clade Ib viruses reported internationally, consistent with patients’ travel histories. All isolates exhibited a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region and 52–61 amino acid substitutions compared with the clade Ia reference. Genome sequences were submitted to GISAID and NCBI to support outbreak response and improve understanding of epidemiologic patterns, enabling more effective public health interventions. IMPORTANCE On 14 August 2024, the World Health Organization declared the monkeypox virus outbreak in Africa a public health emergency of international concern following the emergence of clade Ib. One week later, Thailand confirmed the first monkeypox clade Ib case in Asia. Through whole-genome sequencing and phylogenomic analysis of five cases detected between August 2024 and March 2025, we identified a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region that distinguishes clade Ib from clade Ia. This deletion directly affects the performance of some commercial real-time PCR assays designed for clade Ia, which rely on amplification of the missing genomic region. Our findings highlight important diagnostic limitations that could lead to misinterpretation or reduced sensitivity in routine testing. Beyond confirming regional introduction linked to global spread, this study underscores the critical role of genomic surveillance in ensuring accurate diagnosis, monitoring viral evolution, and strengthening outbreak response as monkeypox continues to expand internationally.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the first monkeypox virus clade Ib cases in Thailand and assess their phylogenetic relationships to understand the emergence and spread of this variant.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed five monkeypox virus clade Ib cases detected in Thailand between August 2024 and March 2025, focusing on their genomic features and international connections.
analysis.methods: Whole-genome sequencing was conducted from lesion swabs of suspected cases, and phylogenomic analysis was performed using global clade Ib sequences from GISAID to compare the Thai isolates.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis confirmed all Thai isolates as clade Ib, showing close relatedness to international clade Ib viruses and a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region along with 52–61 amino acid substitutions compared with the clade Ia reference.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the clade Ib variant in Thailand is genetically distinct from clade Ia and is likely linked to global spread, highlighting the importance of genomic surveillance for accurate diagnosis and outbreak response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform the need for updated diagnostic tools and emphasize the role of genomic surveillance in tracking viral evolution and improving public health interventions against monkeypox.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and focus on a single geographic region, but the evidence is strong due to the use of global reference sequences and direct genomic analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterizes the first monkeypox virus clade Ib cases in Thailand, detected between August 2024 and March 2025. Whole-genome sequencing confirmed their classification as clade Ib, showing genetic similarity to international isolates and a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region compared to clade Ia. The findings highlight the importance of genomic surveillance in tracking the spread of this variant and underscore the need for updated diagnostic methods. The study contributes to understanding the epidemiology of monkeypox and supports public health efforts in outbreak response. However, its small sample size and regional focus limit the generalizability of the results, though the evidence is robust due to the use of global reference sequences.

papers.title_zh: 泰国前 5 例猴痘病毒 Ib 分支病例的基因组特征:2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Following the emergence of monkeypox virus clade Ib in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in August 2024, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern because of sustained transmission and international spread. We characterized the first clade Ib cases detected in Thailand between August 2024 and March 2025 and assessed their phylogenetic relationships. Whole-genome sequencing was performed from lesion swabs of suspected cases. Phylogenetic analysis, incorporating clade Ia ( DQ011155.1 ) and global clade Ib sequences from GISAID, confirmed all Thai isolates as clade Ib. The genomes showed close relatedness to clade Ib viruses reported internationally, consistent with patients’ travel histories. All isolates exhibited a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region and 52–61 amino acid substitutions compared with the clade Ia reference. Genome sequences were submitted to GISAID and NCBI to support outbreak response and improve understanding of epidemiologic patterns, enabling more effective public health interventions. IMPORTANCE On 14 August 2024, the World Health Organization declared the monkeypox virus outbreak in Africa a public health emergency of international concern following the emergence of clade Ib. One week later, Thailand confirmed the first monkeypox clade Ib case in Asia. Through whole-genome sequencing and phylogenomic analysis of five cases detected between August 2024 and March 2025, we identified a 1,140-bp deletion in the C3L gene region that distinguishes clade Ib from clade Ia. This deletion directly affects the performance of some commercial real-time PCR assays designed for clade Ia, which rely on amplification of the missing genomic region. Our findings highlight important diagnostic limitations that could lead to misinterpretation or reduced sensitivity in routine testing. Beyond confirming regional introduction linked to global spread, this study underscores the critical role of genomic surveillance in ensuring accurate diagnosis, monitoring viral evolution, and strengthening outbreak response as monkeypox continues to expand internationally.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 2024 年 8 月刚果民主共和国出现猴痘病毒 Ib 分支后,由于 传播 的持续传播和国际传播,世界卫生组织宣布该病毒为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。我们对 2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月期间在泰国发现的第一批 Ib 分支病例进行了特征分析,并评估了它们的系统发育关系。对疑似病例的病变拭子进行全 基因组 测序。系统发育分析,结合来自 GISAID 的进化枝 Ia (DQ011155.1) 和全局进化枝 Ib 序列,确认所有泰国分离株均为进化枝 Ib。基因组 显示与国际报道的 Ib 分支病毒密切相关,与患者的旅行史一致。与进化枝 Ia 参考相比,所有分离株在 C3L 基因区域均表现出 1,140 bp 缺失和 52-61 个氨基酸取代。基因组 序列已提交给 GISAID 和 NCBI,以支持 暴发 响应并提高对流行病学模式的理解,从而实现更有效的公共卫生干预措施。重要性 2024 年 8 月 14 日,世界卫生组织宣布非洲猴痘病毒 暴发 为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件,继出现 Ib 分支后。一周后,泰国确认亚洲首例猴痘分支Ib病例。通过对 2024 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月期间检测到的 5 个病例进行全 基因组 测序和系统发育分析,我们在 C3L 基因区域中发现了一个 1,140 bp 的缺失,该缺失将分支 Ib 与分支 Ia 区分开来。这种缺失直接影响了一些为进化枝 Ia 设计的商业实时 PCR 检测的性能,这些检测依赖于缺失基因组区域的扩增。我们的研究结果强调了重要的诊断局限性,这些局限性可能导致常规检测中的误解或敏感性降低。除了确认区域引入与全球传播相关之外,这项研究还强调了 基因组监测 在确保准确的 诊断、监测病毒 进化 以及随着猴痘继续在国际上蔓延而加强 暴发 应对方面的关键作用。

papers.title: Shortening outbreak-response delays: A multi-source synthesis of six lessons from Sierra Leone’s 2025 clade IIb mpox response
papers.abstract: Sierra Leone confirmed mpox on January 10, 2025, and declared an emergency three days later. National surveillance recorded 5,442 confirmed cases and 60 deaths (1.1%) through December 14. The last case received laboratory confirmation on October 25. The outbreak was declared over on December 15. We identified operational lessons for shortening future outbreak-response delays. analysis.summary_en: This review analyzes Sierra Leone’s 2025 clade IIb mpox outbreak response to identify operational lessons for reducing delays in future outbreaks. The review synthesizes data from national surveillance, field experience, and genomic reconstruction, highlighting six key strategies. These include improving care-seeking confidentiality, enhancing rash recognition and sampling, and ensuring timely communication of results. The outbreak was declared over on December 15, but the possibility of undetected transmission remains. The review also notes that the median onset-to-confirmation interval was eight days, with early cases presenting five days after onset. A proposed district package aims to implement these lessons through structured indicators and resources for future evaluation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于猴痘病毒,特别是clade IIb MPXV,并考察了塞拉利昂2025年的暴发响应。核心问题是:如何通过操作经验来缩短暴发响应延迟。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对塞拉利昂2025年clade IIb 猴痘响应的回顾性综合,采用文件分析、三角验证和非正式专家共识方法。证据包括现场经验、全国监测和响应评估报告、早期44例分析、一项涉及140名参与者的四个区定性研究,以及基因组重建。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述识别了六个用于缩短暴发响应延迟的操作经验,包括改善从发病到就诊、从就诊到可操作的诊断,以及从诊断到实施支持性传播中断措施的延迟。最后一例确诊病例是在10月25日,暴发于12月15日被宣布结束。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 宣布暴发结束并不排除未被检测到的传播的可能性。此外,从发病到确诊的中位数间隔为8天,早期病例在发病后中位数为5天出现,突显了及时检测和响应方面的挑战。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述提出了一种区级方案,将识别出的经验教训与负责官员、指标、审查触发条件以及用于前瞻性评估的资源联系起来。它强调了持续监测、快速诊断和有效传达结果的必要性,以减少暴发响应的延迟。

papers.abstract_zh: 塞拉利昂于2025年1月10日确认猴痘,并在三天后宣布进入紧急状态。全国监测记录了截至2025年12月14日的5,442例确诊病例和60例死亡(1.1%)。最后一例确诊病例于10月25日获得实验室确认。暴发于12月15日被宣布结束。我们识别了缩短未来暴发响应延迟的操作经验。通过文件分析、三角验证和非正式专家共识,我们回顾性地综合了1月至12月的响应情况。资料来源包括现场经验、全国监测和响应评估报告、早期44例分析、一项涉及140名参与者的四个区定性研究,以及基因组重建。六个经验教训涉及从发病到就诊、从就诊到可操作的诊断,以及从诊断到实施支持性传播中断措施的延迟。早期病例在发病后中位数为5天出现。从发病到确诊的中位数间隔为8天。基因组模型估计感染人数约为10,400例(95%最高后验密度区间为7,000–15,200),而该分析中实验室确诊病例为5,096例。区级团队应保护保密的就医行为,持续识别皮疹并进行采样,追踪结果传达情况。他们应支持可行的隔离措施,规划持续的人员配置,并将样本与国家和区域测序联系起来。在增强响应阶段之前,通知数量有所下降,且同时进行的干预措施防止了单独的效果估计。宣布暴发结束并不排除未被检测到的传播。提出的区级方案将这些经验教训与负责官员、指标、审查触发条件以及用于前瞻性评估的资源联系起来。

papers.title: Short-term adverse events following modified vaccinia Ankara–Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) mpox vaccine with and without concomitant vaccines, Australia, 2022 to 2023
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Modified vaccinia Ankara–Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) mpox vaccine is used globally for disease prevention. Real-world safety data following co-administration of MVA-BN with other vaccines is limited. AIM To characterise the adverse event profile of MVA-BN given alone or concomitantly with other vaccines using data from Australia’s active vaccine safety surveillance (AusVaxSafety). METHODS Individuals (≥ 18 years) who received MVA-BN between 30 August 2022 and 20 April 2023 at sentinel AusVaxSafety surveillance sites and registered via QR code were surveyed on days 7 and 14 post-vaccination regarding adverse events following immunisation (AEFI), medical review by a healthcare professional and impact on daily activities. Analyses included participants who completed both surveys. Outcomes were compared by administration route, dose and concomitant vaccination status. RESULTS Among 10,943 participants (response rate: 46%; 97% male), 200 (1.8%) received at least one concomitant vaccine. Across 14 days, AEFI rates were comparable or lower in concomitant recipients following intradermal administration (alone: 56% (Dose 1), 36% (Dose 2) vs concomitant: 53% (Dose 1), 32% (Dose 2)) and subcutaneous administration (alone: 49% (Dose 1), 32% (Dose 2) vs concomitant: 28% (Dose 1) and 24% (Dose 2)). Medical review was uncommon (0–2.7%). Impact on daily activities was low across groups (6% vs 3.5%), with most symptoms lasting ≤ 1 day. CONCLUSION The frequency and severity of AEFIs within 14 days post-vaccination were similar between concomitant and non-concomitant group. These findings provide preliminary, exploratory evidence supporting the safe co-administration of MVA-BN with other adult vaccines, primarily in adult men, and may help inform future immunisation policy and public health recommendations.

papers.title_original: Short-term adverse events following modified vaccinia Ankara–Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) mpox vaccine with and without concomitant vaccines, Australia, 2022 to 2023

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Mpox virus (Orthopoxvirus monkeypox), specifically examining the short-term adverse events following modified vaccinia Ankara–Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) mpox vaccine administration, both alone and in combination with other vaccines, in Australia from August 2022 to April 2023. The central question is to characterise the adverse event profile of MVA-BN in this context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes data from Australia’s active vaccine safety surveillance system (AusVaxSafety), where individuals aged ≥ 18 years who received MVA-BN between 30 August 2022 and 20 April 2023 were surveyed on days 7 and 14 post-vaccination. Analyses were restricted to participants who completed both surveys. The study design is observational, with real-world safety data collected through self-reported adverse events and medical review by healthcare professionals.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The frequency and severity of adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) within 14 days post-vaccination were found to be similar between individuals who received MVA-BN alone and those who received it concomitantly with other vaccines. AEFI rates were comparable or lower in concomitant recipients, regardless of administration route (intradermal or subcutaneous). Medical review was uncommon, and the impact on daily activities was low across all groups.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that real-world safety data on co-administration of MVA-BN with other vaccines is limited. The study population was predominantly male (97%), which may limit the generalisability of findings to other demographics. Additionally, the review does not provide detailed information on the specific types of adverse events or their severity distribution.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that the co-administration of MVA-BN with other adult vaccines may be safe, particularly in adult men. These results may inform future immunisation policy and public health recommendations, but further research is needed to evaluate safety in broader populations and to explore the mechanisms behind any observed differences in adverse events.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the short-term safety of the MVA-BN mpox vaccine in Australia, focusing on adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) when administered alone or with other vaccines. The study, conducted between August 2022 and April 2023, involved 10,943 participants, with a 46% response rate. AEFI rates were comparable or lower in concomitant recipients, regardless of administration route. Medical review was uncommon, and most symptoms lasted ≤ 1 day. The findings support the safe co-administration of MVA-BN with other vaccines, primarily in adult men, and may guide future immunisation policies. However, the study's limited population diversity and lack of detailed adverse event analysis highlight the need for further research.

elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes data from Australia’s active vaccine safety surveillance system (AusVaxSafety), where individuals aged ≥ 18 years who received MVA-BN between 30 August 2022 and 20 April 2023 were surveyed on days 7 and 14 post-vaccination. Analyses were restricted to participants who completed both surveys. The study design is observational, with real-world safety data collected through self-reported adverse events and medical review by healthcare professionals.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The frequency and severity of adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) within 14 days post-vaccination were found to be similar between individuals who received MVA-BN alone and those who received it concomitantly with other vaccines. AEFI rates were comparable or lower in concomitant recipients, regardless of administration route (intradermal or subcutaneous). Medical review was uncommon, and the impact on daily activities was low across all groups.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that real-world safety data on co-administration of MVA-BN with other vaccines is limited. The study population was predominantly male (97%), which may limit the generalisability of findings to other demographics. Additionally, the review does not provide detailed information on the specific types of adverse events or their severity distribution.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that the co-administration of MVA-BN with other adult vaccines may be safe, particularly in adult men. These results may inform future immunisation policy and public health recommendations, but further research is needed to evaluate safety in broader populations and to explore the mechanisms behind any observed differences in adverse events.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础包括澳大利亚主动 疫苗 安全性 监测 系统(AusVaxSafety)中的数据,该系统对 2022 年 8 月 30 日至 2023 年 4 月 20 日期间接种 MVA-BN 并通过二维码注册的年龄≥18岁的个体,在接种后第 7 天和第 14 天进行不良事件调查。分析仅限于完成两次调查的参与者。研究设计为观察性研究,通过自我报告的不良事件和医疗专业人员的医学评估收集真实世界的安全性数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在接种后 14 天内,无论个体是单独接种 MVA-BN 还是与其他 疫苗 联合接种,不良事件(AEFI)的发生频率和严重程度均相似。无论采用皮内还是皮下接种途径,同时接种的个体中 AEFI 发生率均相似或更低。医疗评估较为罕见,所有组别中对日常活动的影响均较低。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,关于 MVA-BN 与其他 疫苗 联合接种的真实世界安全性数据仍然有限。研究人群主要为男性(97%),这可能限制了研究结果在其他人群中的适用性。此外,综述未提供关于具体不良事件类型或其严重程度分布的详细信息。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,MVA-BN 与其他成人 疫苗 联合接种可能是安全的,尤其是在成人男性中。这些结果可能为未来的疫苗接种政策和公共卫生建议提供参考,但需要进一步研究以评估更广泛人群中的安全性,并探索观察到的不良事件差异的潜在机制。

papers.title_zh: 接受改良安卡拉痘苗病毒–巴伐利亚北欧(MVA-BN)猴痘 疫苗 单独或与其他 疫苗 同时接种后短期不良事件,澳大利亚,2022年至2023年
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Modified vaccinia Ankara–Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) mpox vaccine is used globally for disease prevention. Real-world safety data following co-administration of MVA-BN with other vaccines is limited. AIM To characterise the adverse event profile of MVA-BN given alone or concomitantly with other vaccines using data from Australia’s active vaccine safety surveillance (AusVaxSafety). METHODS Individuals (≥ 18 years) who received MVA-BN between 30 August 2022 and 20 April 2023 at sentinel AusVaxSafety surveillance sites and registered via QR code were surveyed on days 7 and 14 post-vaccination regarding adverse events following immunisation (AEFI), medical review by a healthcare professional and impact on daily activities. Analyses included participants who completed both surveys. Outcomes were compared by administration route, dose and concomitant vaccination status. RESULTS Among 10,943 participants (response rate: 46%; 97% male), 200 (1.8%) received at least one concomitant vaccine. Across 14 days, AEFI rates were comparable or lower in concomitant recipients following intradermal administration (alone: 56% (Dose 1), 36% (Dose 2) vs concomitant: 53% (Dose 1), 32% (Dose 2)) and subcutaneous administration (alone: 49% (Dose 1), 32% (Dose 2) vs concomitant: 28% (Dose 1) and 24% (Dose 2)). Medical review was uncommon (0–2.7%). Impact on daily activities was low across groups (6% vs 3.5%), with most symptoms lasting ≤ 1 day. CONCLUSION The frequency and severity of AEFIs within 14 days post-vaccination were similar between concomitant and non-concomitant group. These findings provide preliminary, exploratory evidence supporting the safe co-administration of MVA-BN with other adult vaccines, primarily in adult men, and may help inform future immunisation policy and public health recommendations.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:改良安卡拉痘苗病毒–巴伐利亚北欧(MVA-BN)猴痘 疫苗 被全球用于疾病预防。目前关于 MVA-BN 与其他 疫苗 联合接种后的实际安全性数据有限。目的:利用澳大利亚主动 疫苗 安全性 监测(AusVaxSafety)系统中的数据,描述 MVA-BN 单独或与其他 疫苗 同时接种后的不良事件特征。方法:在 2022 年 8 月 30 日至 2023 年 4 月 20 日期间,通过哨点 AusVaxSafety 监测 站点接种 MVA-BN 并通过二维码注册的年龄≥18岁的个体,在接种后第 7 天和第 14 天被调查其接种后的不良事件(AEFI)、医疗专业人员的医学评估及对日常活动的影响。分析仅包括完成两次调查的参与者。根据接种途径、剂量和是否同时接种其他 疫苗 的状态比较结果。结果:在 10,943 名参与者中(响应率:46%;97% 为男性),有 200 名(1.8%)接受了至少一种同时接种的 疫苗。在接种后 14 天内,无论采用皮内接种(单独:56%(剂量 1),36%(剂量 2) vs 同时接种:53%(剂量 1),32%(剂量 2))还是皮下接种(单独:49%(剂量 1),32%(剂量 2) vs 同时接种:28%(剂量 1)和 24%(剂量 2)),AEFI 发生率均相似或更低。医疗评估较为罕见(0–2.7%)。所有组别中,对日常活动的影响均较低(6% vs 3.5%),大多数症状持续时间≤1 天。结论:在接种后 14 天内,单独接种和同时接种其他 疫苗 的个体中,不良事件(AEFI)的发生频率和严重程度相似。这些发现提供了初步的、探索性的证据,支持 MVA-BN 与其他成人 疫苗 联合接种的安全性,尤其是在成人男性中。这些结果可能有助于未来疫苗接种政策和公共卫生建议的制定。

papers.title: Community-Based Surveillance in Uganda's Border Districts during the 2024 Mpox Outbreak: Enablers, Constraints, and Adaptive Responses
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Uganda's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response framework designates community-based surveillance (CBS) as a core pillar of outbreak detection, yet how this pillar functions during a live, stigmatised, cross-border outbreak remains poorly understood. This study qualitatively examined CBS during the 2024 Mpox Clade Ib outbreak in Uganda's Kasese and Amuru border districts, focusing on the enablers, constraints, and adaptive responses shaping surveillance performance. Methods A qualitative descriptive design was employed, with data collected between June and August 2025 through 19 key informant interviews and 8 focus group discussions, engaging 100 participants across the two districts. Participants included Health-sector personnel, implementing partner staff, Community Health Workers (CHWs), and community members. Data were analysed thematically. Results Three interrelated themes emerged. Institutional memory and pre-existing infrastructure from prior outbreaks (Ebola, COVID-19, and the 2022 Mpox outbreak) strengthened clinical suspicion, reactivated standing response structures, and sustained community trust and partner support. Structural and social barriers, including delayed disbursement of funds, fragile specimen transport, limited staff, fragmented coordination, and stigma linked to both the sexualised transmission narrative and the confusion of Mpox with locally recognised skin conditions, drove concealment and care seeking outside the formal system. Communities responded with improvised adaptive mechanisms, including informal self-diagnosis, peer-based referral networks among key populations, informal cross-border resource-sharing and integration of Mpox screening into existing platforms such as antenatal and HIV/ART clinics. Conclusions Strengthening CBS in Uganda's border districts requires reliable financing, sustainable specimen transport, adequate staffing, locally appropriate risk communication, and formalised cross-border collaboration as a deliberate component of preparedness in high-mobility border settings.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study in Uganda's border districts during the 2024 mpox outbreak explored the functioning of community-based surveillance, highlighting the importance of institutional memory and infrastructure, while also identifying significant barriers to effective surveillance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解在乌干达边境地区发生、存在污名化且跨境的猴痘 暴发期间,基于社区的监测(CBS)是如何运作的,以填补此类环境下CBS有效性的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 于2025年6月至8月期间,在Kasese和Amuru边境地区开展了一项定性描述性研究,包括19次关键信息提供者访谈和8次焦点小组讨论,共涉及100名参与者,包括卫生部门人员、实施伙伴员工、社区卫生工作者(CHWs)和社区成员。
elements_zh.methods: 数据通过关键信息提供者访谈和焦点小组讨论收集,并采用主题分析法进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 出现了三个主题:从以往暴发中积累的制度记忆和现有基础设施、结构性和社会性障碍,以及社区的适应性反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究强调了制度记忆和现有基础设施在增强临床怀疑和重新激活响应结构中的作用,同时指出了显著的结构性和社会性障碍,这些障碍阻碍了监测的运作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,可靠的融资、可持续的样本运输、充足的人员配备、适合本地的风险沟通,以及正式的跨境合作对于强化高流动性边境地区的CBS至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的定性性质和有限的样本量可能限制其结果的普遍适用性,且研究结果特定于研究背景,可能无法直接应用于其他环境。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 乌干达的综合疾病监测与响应框架将基于社区的监测(CBS)指定为暴发监测的核心支柱,但该支柱在实际发生、存在污名化且跨境的暴发中的运作情况仍不明确。本研究采用定性方法,考察了2024年猴痘 Clade Ib 暴发期间乌干达Kasese和Amuru边境地区的CBS,重点关注塑造监测表现的促进因素、限制因素和适应性反应。方法 采用定性描述性设计,于2025年6月至8月期间,通过19次关键信息提供者访谈和8次焦点小组讨论收集数据,共涉及两个边境地区的100名参与者。参与者包括卫生部门人员、实施伙伴员工、社区卫生工作者(CHWs)和社区成员。数据采用主题分析法进行分析。结果 出现了三个相互关联的主题。从以往暴发(埃博拉、新冠和2022年猴痘 暴发)中积累的制度记忆和现有基础设施增强了临床怀疑,重新激活了既有的响应结构,并维持了社区信任和合作伙伴支持。结构性和社会性障碍,包括资金发放延迟、脆弱的样本运输、人员不足、协调碎片化以及与性化传播叙事和猴痘与当地已知皮肤病混淆相关的污名,导致了隐瞒行为和在非正式系统中寻求护理。社区通过自发的适应性机制作出回应,包括非正式的自我诊断、关键人群中的基于同伴的转介网络、非正式的跨境资源分享,以及将猴痘筛查整合到现有平台(如产前检查和HIV/ART诊所)中。结论 强化乌干达边境地区的CBS需要可靠的融资、可持续的样本运输、充足的人员配备、适合本地的风险沟通,以及在高流动性边境环境中将正式的跨境合作作为准备工作的有意组成部分。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解在乌干达边境地区发生、存在污名化且跨境的猴痘 暴发期间,基于社区的监测(CBS)是如何运作的,以填补此类环境下CBS有效性的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 于2025年6月至8月期间,在Kasese和Amuru边境地区开展了一项定性描述性研究,包括19次关键信息提供者访谈和8次焦点小组讨论,共涉及100名参与者,包括卫生部门人员、实施伙伴员工、社区卫生工作者(CHWs)和社区成员。
analysis_zh.methods: 数据通过关键信息提供者访谈和焦点小组讨论收集,并采用主题分析法进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 出现了三个主题:从以往暴发中积累的制度记忆和现有基础设施、结构性和社会性障碍,以及社区的适应性反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究强调了制度记忆和现有基础设施在增强临床怀疑和重新激活响应结构中的作用,同时指出了显著的结构性和社会性障碍,这些障碍阻碍了监测的运作。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,可靠的融资、可持续的样本运输、充足的人员配备、适合本地的风险沟通,以及正式的跨境合作对于强化高流动性边境地区的CBS至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的定性性质和有限的样本量可能限制其结果的普遍适用性,且研究结果特定于研究背景,可能无法直接应用于其他环境。

papers.title: Employing a Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Monkeypox Disease in Conjunction with the Influence of Rudraksha Beads
papers.abstract: With the decline in COVID-19 cases, another virus affecting human life emerged, the Monkeypox virus. People were highly concerned, believing that it might spread in a manner similar to COVID-19. Therefore, early detection is vital to prevent substantial community transmission. AI-based detection methods may help identify cases at an early stage. Moreover, this study explores the supplementary impact of Rudraksha beads on enhancing prediction precision. In this work, various supervised machine learning models, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM, are examined for detecting Monkeypox. The study also considers the potential influence of Rudraksha beads, traditionally associated with spiritual and therapeutic attributes and believed to possess distinctive vibrational properties. The methodology involves comprehensive clinical data collection, including patient records, medical histories, and diagnostic test results. Models incorporating regularization techniques are trained and evaluated to predict Monkeypox occurrence. Additionally, correlation analysis is performed to 142 assess associations with Rudraksha bead usage. The performance is evaluated using precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, showing promising results for large-scale screening.

papers.title: Global health security and smallpox: A strategic review of post-eradication biosafety and preparedness.
papers.abstract: Abstract The global biosecurity framework faces a potential critical transition driven by synthetic biology advancements and declining population-level immunity. This review evaluates smallpox as a central case study for contemporary pathogen governance and biopolitical preparedness. We analyze the convergence of two primary risks: the technical feasibility of de novo orthopoxvirus synthesis and the expanding immunity gap following the cessation of routine vaccination. The 2022 mpox resurgence is assessed as a sentinel event revealing strategic vulnerabilities in cross-protective immunity. Ultimately, this perspective argues that smallpox reemergence risk is not merely a technological byproduct, but a fundamental global governance crisis. To mitigate these threats, we propose a multidimensional framework integrated with One Health principles and transnational coordination. Maintaining strategic vigilance and institutional memory is presented as a critical political capacity for post-eradication health security.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 全球生物安全框架正面临由合成生物学进展和人群免疫水平下降引发的潜在关键转变。本综述将天花作为当代病原体治理和生物政治应急准备的核心案例进行分析。我们探讨了两种主要风险的交汇:从头合成正痘病毒的技术可行性以及常规疫苗接种停止后免疫差距的扩大。2022年猴痘的再次暴发被评估为一个警示事件,揭示了交叉保护性免疫中的战略脆弱性。最终,本视角认为,天花重新出现的风险不仅仅是一个技术副产品,而是一个根本性的全球治理危机。为应对这些威胁,我们提出一个与One Health原则和跨国协调相结合的多维框架。保持战略警觉和制度记忆被呈现为后根除时代卫生安全的关键政治能力。

papers.title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
papers.abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. The review highlights that only 46.8% of HCWs have adequate knowledge about Mpox, despite its high case fatality rate in the region. papers.title: Severe Monkeypox in an Immunocompromised HIV-Positive Patient: A Case Report of Extensive Necrotic Perineal Lesions and Ocular Involvement
papers.abstract: Background: Monkeypox is a zoonotic virus that is usually self-limiting in most patients. However, in close to 40%, complications such as proctalgia, penile edema, and skin and anorectal abscesses may arise and warrant antiviral therapy, pain control, and antibacterial therapy in cases of bacterial co-infection. Co-infection of monkeypox infection and HIV is associated with significant morbidity and severe clinical manifestations with multi-organ involvement. Case Presentation: We present a 43-year-old HIV positive woman with advanced immunosuppression and monkeypox co-infection. The patient presented with extensive necrotic perineal lesions, ocular ulcers, and widespread skin involvement. Nystatin and fluconazole were used to manage suspected fungal superinfection. Albumin supplementation and intravenous Kabiven supported nutritional and fluid balance. Daily warm saline baths and calamine lotion provided wound hygiene and relief from pruritus. Morphine was administered to control pain effectively. Clindamycin, doxycycline, and ciprofloxacin targeted secondary bacterial infections. Enoxaparin was administered for thromboprophylaxis due to immobility and systemic inflammation. Conclusion: This case underscores the devastating impact of mpox in immunosuppressed patients, especially those with HIV and poor ART adherence. Despite the undetectable viral load, the patient’s low CD4 count promoted widespread necrotic lesions, ocular complications, and possible hepatic dysfunction, highlighting the need for careful organ monitoring. Comprehensive care, including ART adherence, remains essential to improving outcomes in such complex presentations.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘是一种人兽共患病病毒,通常在大多数患者中呈自限性。然而,接近40%的患者可能出现并发症,如肛门疼痛、阴茎水肿和皮肤及肛周脓肿,需要病例报告治疗、疼痛控制和抗菌治疗,特别是在出现细菌共感染的情况下。猴痘感染与HIV共感染与显著的发病率和严重的临床表现有关,表现为多器官受累。病例报告:我们报告了一例43岁HIV阳性女性患者,其免疫功能严重低下并伴有猴痘共感染。患者出现广泛的坏死性会阴病变、眼部溃疡和全身性皮肤受累。使用念珠菌素和氟康唑来管理疑似真菌继发感染。补充白蛋白和静脉注射Kabiven以维持营养和体液平衡。每日温盐水浴和炉甘石洗剂用于伤口清洁和缓解瘙痒。使用吗啡有效控制疼痛。克林霉素、多西环素和环丙沙星用于针对继发性细菌感染。由于活动受限和全身炎症,使用依诺肝素进行抗凝预防。结论:该病例强调了猴痘在免疫功能低下的患者中可能造成的严重后果,尤其是那些HIV阳性且抗逆转录病毒治疗(ART)依从性差的患者。尽管病毒载量不可检测,但患者低CD4计数导致了广泛的坏死性病变、眼部并发症和可能的肝功能障碍,突显了对器官进行仔细监测的必要性。综合治疗,包括ART依从性,对于改善此类复杂病例的预后仍至关重要。

papers.title: Structure of MPXV DNA ligase complex reveals a virus-specific pocket for selective inhibition.
papers.abstract: Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), remains a public health concern, yet the structural basis of poxvirus DNA ligase function has been poorly defined despite strong genetic and biochemical evidence supporting its essential role in viral DNA replication and repair. Here, we report the crystal structure of MPXV DNA ligase (MpxvLig) in complex with nicked DNA at 2.04 Å resolution. MpxvLig adopts the canonical three-domain architecture of ATP-dependent DNA ligases, comprising an N-terminal DNA-binding domain (DBD), a nucleotidyltransferase domain, and a C-terminal oligonucleotide-binding fold domain (OBD), which together form a clamp-like configuration that embraces nicked DNA for catalysis. The structure captures MpxvLig in an active catalytic state corresponding to the adenylylation step, in which Lys233 forms a covalent ligase-AMP intermediate. Comparative structural and biochemical analyses with the catalytic core of human DNA ligase III reveal substantial differences in domain arrangement and DNA engagement, consistent with the stronger DNA-binding capacity and higher ligation activity of MpxvLig in vitro . Small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) further shows that apo-MpxvLig adopts an extended flashlight-like conformation in solution. Notably, we identify a virus-specific small-molecule-binding pocket within the DNA-binding domain. Mitoxantrone binds directly to this pocket and inhibits MpxvLig activity at micromolar concentrations, while exerting minimal effects on the human ligase. Mutations in pocket-defining residues markedly attenuate this inhibition, supporting an on-target mechanism. Together, these findings establish the structural basis of poxvirus DNA ligation and provide a framework for the rational development of selective antiviral inhibitors targeting MpxvLig.

papers.source_body_en: Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), remains a public health concern, yet the structural basis of poxvirus DNA ligase function has been poorly defined despite strong genetic and biochemical evidence supporting its essential role in viral DNA replication and repair. Here, we report the crystal structure of MPXV DNA ligase (MpxvLig) in complex with nicked DNA at 2.04 Å resolution. MpxvLig adopts the canonical three-domain architecture of ATP-dependent DNA ligases, comprising an N-terminal DNA-binding domain (DBD), a nucleotidyltransferase domain, and a C-terminal oligonucleotide-binding fold domain (OBD), which together form a clamp-like configuration that embraces nicked DNA for catalysis. The structure captures MpxvLig in an active catalytic state corresponding to the adenylylation step, in which Lys233 forms a covalent ligase-AMP intermediate. Comparative structural and biochemical analyses with the catalytic core of human DNA ligase III reveal substantial differences in domain arrangement and DNA engagement, consistent with the stronger DNA-binding capacity and higher ligation activity of MpxvLig in vitro . Small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) further shows that apo-MpxvLig adopts an extended flashlight-like conformation in solution. Notably, we identify a virus-specific small-molecule-binding pocket within the DNA-binding domain. Mitoxantrone binds directly to this pocket and inhibits MpxvLig activity at micromolar concentrations, while exerting minimal effects on the human ligase. Mutations in pocket-defining residues markedly attenuate this inhibition, supporting an on-target mechanism. Together, these findings establish the structural basis of poxvirus DNA ligation and provide a framework for the rational development of selective antiviral inhibitors targeting MpxvLig.

papers.title: Analysis of pathological changes and virus-susceptible cells in the testes following MPXV infection in a rhesus macaque model.
papers.abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an emerging public health threat, with increasing epidemiological and clinical evidence supporting sexual transmission, including detection of viral DNA in semen. However, the pathogenic mechanisms of MPXV within the male reproductive system remain poorly defined. We employed a rhesus macaque model to investigate MPXV-induced testicular alterations. Combining bulk RNA sequencing, histopathological analysis and immunofluorescence staining, we characterized testicular pathology, viral antigen distribution, and host responses during the early stage of infection. We found that MPXV did not induce marked inflammation or widespread cell death, and seminiferous tubule architecture remained largely intact during infection. Furthermore, within seminiferous tubules, Sertoli cells showed higher proportion of MPXV antigen co-localization than spermatogonia and spermatocytes, whereas in the interstitium, vascular endothelial cells and immune cells, including macrophages and T cells, showed prominent MPXV antigen detection, consistent with a potential contribution of hematogenous dissemination to testicular involvement. MPXV infection was associated with downregulation of the Sertoli cell marker SOX9 and alterations in tight junction-associated proteins, suggesting changes in Sertoli cell characteristics and BTB-associated molecular features. Transcriptomic analysis revealed changes in interferon-related antiviral pathways and complement-related gene expression, with C1q-positive signals detected in both interstitial and seminiferous tubular regions. In addition, changes in spermatogenesis-related gene expression were observed, which may reflect alterations in the spermatogenic microenvironment. Collectively, this study provides a quantitative characterization of early MPXV-testis interactions and cellular tropism across multiple testicular cell types in a non-human primate model, and provides insights into the pathological and immune responses associated with MPXV infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种新兴的公共卫生威胁,越来越多的流行病学和临床证据支持其与性传播相关的可能性,包括在精液中检测到病毒DNA。然而,MPXV在男性生殖系统中的致病机制仍不明确。我们采用恒河猴模型来研究MPXV引起的睾丸改变。通过结合批量RNA测序、组织病理学分析和免疫荧光染色,我们描述了感染早期睾丸病理变化、病毒抗原分布以及宿主反应。研究发现,MPXV并未引起显著的炎症或广泛的细胞死亡,且在感染期间,生精小管的结构基本保持完整。此外,在生精小管内,支持细胞(Sertoli cells)中MPXV抗原共定位的比例高于精原细胞和精母细胞,而在间质中,血管内皮细胞和免疫细胞(包括巨噬细胞和T细胞)显示出显著的MPXV抗原检测,这与潜在的血源性传播导致睾丸受累一致。MPXV感染与支持细胞标志物SOX9的下调以及紧密连接相关蛋白的改变有关,提示支持细胞特征和BTB相关分子特征的变化。转录组分析显示干扰素相关抗病毒药物通路和补体相关基因表达发生了变化,并在间质和生精小管区域检测到C1q阳性信号。此外,还观察到与生精相关的基因表达变化,这可能反映了生精微环境的改变。综上所述,本研究在非人灵长类模型中提供了对早期MPXV-睾丸相互作用和多种睾丸细胞类型的病毒易感性的定量描述,并为MPXV感染的病理和免疫应答提供了见解。

papers.title: Whole-genome characterization of Candidozyma auris isolates from a Korean tertiary care centre: clade II predominance, partly unexplained fluconazole resistance and a clade I isolate
papers.abstract: In South Korea, Candidozyma auris is dominated by ear-associated clade II isolates, but institution-based genomic data remain limited. We analysed 35 archived isolates from 29 patients at a tertiary care centre between 2017 and 2023 using antifungal susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing. Thirty-four isolates belonged to clade II, and one urine isolate recovered after inter-hospital transfer belonged to subclade Ib. Serial clade II isolates from the same patient clustered together and had lower pairwise SNP distances than different-patient pairs (median, 8.5 versus 181). Among the first isolates from 29 patients, 14 (48.3%) were fluconazole resistant. In first clade II isolates, recurrent curated coding variation was concentrated in TAC1B and ERG11 ; TAC1B F214S and W198C and ERG11 K143R occurred only in resistant isolates, but recognized coding variants did not account for all resistant isolates. Clade II isolates shared a broadly conserved subtelomeric deletion backbone, with variable chromosome 6 loss of selected glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchor genes. The clade Ib isolate carried ERG11 Y132F, TAC1B A583S and a CDR1 V704L/E709D-like change and met CDC tentative breakpoints for resistance to fluconazole, amphotericin B and caspofungin. These findings refine the genomic profile of Korean clade II isolates and highlight the potential introduction of a distinct clade I lineage through healthcare transfer.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the genomic profile of Candidozyma auris isolates in South Korea and investigate the prevalence of fluconazole resistance, particularly in clade II isolates, to address the limited institution-based genomic data available.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 35 archived isolates from 29 patients at a tertiary care centre between 2017 and 2023, including both clade II and a single clade Ib isolate recovered after inter-hospital transfer.
analysis.methods: Whole-genome sequencing and antifungal susceptibility testing were used to analyze the isolates, with a focus on identifying genomic variations and resistance patterns.
analysis.main_results: Thirty-four isolates belonged to clade II, and one urine isolate from a different patient belonged to subclade Ib. Serial clade II isolates from the same patient had lower pairwise SNP distances compared to isolates from different patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the predominance of clade II isolates in South Korea and suggest the potential introduction of a distinct clade I lineage through healthcare transfer, which may have implications for understanding resistance mechanisms.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the genomic diversity and resistance patterns of Candidozyma auris in South Korea, which can inform surveillance and diagnostic strategies for fungal infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single tertiary care centre and relies on archived isolates, which may affect generalisability. The evidence is moderate due to the focus on a specific geographic location and the use of historical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterizes the genomic profile of Candidozyma auris isolates from a Korean tertiary care centre, revealing clade II predominance and the presence of a clade Ib isolate. It highlights the potential introduction of a distinct clade I lineage through healthcare transfer and identifies genomic variations associated with fluconazole resistance. The findings contribute to understanding the genetic diversity and resistance mechanisms of Candidozyma auris in South Korea, which can inform surveillance and diagnostic practices. However, the study's reliance on archived isolates from a single institution limits its generalisability, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

papers.abstract_zh: 在韩国,Candidozyma auris主要由与耳部相关的II类菌株组成,但基于机构的基因组数据仍较为有限。我们分析了2017年至2023年间在一家三级医疗机构中从29名患者分离的35株存档菌株,采用抗真菌药物敏感性试验和全基因组测序。其中34株属于II类菌株,而一株通过医院间转移获得的尿液分离株属于子类Ib。来自同一患者的连续II类菌株聚类在一起,其成对SNP距离低于不同患者之间的菌株(中位数,8.5 vs 181)。在29名患者的首次分离株中,有14株(48.3%)表现出氟康唑耐药性。在首次分离的II类菌株中,反复出现的编码变异主要集中在TAC1B和ERG11基因;TAC1B F214S和W198C以及ERG11 K143R仅出现在耐药菌株中,但已知的编码变异并未解释所有耐药菌株。II类菌株共享一个广泛保守的亚端粒区缺失骨架,但染色体6上某些糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定基因的缺失情况存在差异。该Ib类菌株携带ERG11 Y132F、TAC1B A583S以及类似CDR1 V704L/E709D的变异,并符合CDC暂定的氟康唑、两性霉素B和卡泊芬净耐药性标准。这些发现细化了韩国II类菌株的基因组特征,并突出了通过医疗传播可能引入I类菌株的潜在可能性,这可能对理解耐药机制具有重要意义。
papers.summary_zh: 在韩国,Candidozyma auris主要由与耳部相关的II类菌株组成,但基于机构的基因组数据仍较为有限。我们分析了2017年至2023年间在一家三级医疗机构中从29名患者分离的35株存档菌株,采用抗真菌药物敏感性试验和全基因组测序。其中34株属于II类菌株,而一株通过医院间转移获得的尿液分离株属于子类Ib。来自同一患者的连续II类菌株聚类在一起,其成对SNP距离低于不同患者之间的菌株(中位数,8.5 vs 181)。在29名患者的首次分离株中,有14株(48.3%)表现出氟康唑耐药性。在首次分离的II类菌株中,反复出现的编码变异主要集中在TAC1B和ERG11基因;TAC1B F214S和W198C以及ERG11 K143R仅出现在耐药菌株中,但已知的编码变异并未解释所有耐药菌株。II类菌株共享一个广泛保守的亚端粒区缺失骨架,但染色体6上某些糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定基因的缺失情况存在差异。该Ib类菌株携带ERG11 Y132F、TAC1B A583S以及类似CDR1 V704L/E709D的变异,并符合CDC暂定的氟康唑、两性霉素B和卡泊芬净耐药性标准。这些发现细化了韩国II类菌株的基因组特征,并突出了通过医疗传播可能引入I类菌株的潜在可能性,这可能对理解耐药机制具有重要意义。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述韩国Candidozyma auris菌株的基因组特征,并探讨氟康唑耐药性的机制,特别是针对II类菌株,以应对目前基于机构的基因组数据有限的问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了2017年至2023年间在一家三级医疗机构中从29名患者分离的35株存档菌株,包括II类菌株和一株通过医院间转移获得的Ib类菌株。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用全基因组测序和抗真菌药物敏感性试验对菌株进行分析,重点在于识别基因组变异和耐药模式。
analysis_zh.main_results: 34株菌株属于II类,而一株尿液分离株来自另一名患者,属于子类Ib。来自同一患者的连续II类菌株之间的成对SNP距离低于不同患者之间的菌株。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了II类菌株在韩国的主导地位,并表明通过医疗传播可能引入了I类菌株,这可能对理解耐药机制产生影响。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究提供了关于韩国Candidozyma auris菌株基因组多样性和耐药模式的见解,有助于制定基因组监测和真菌感染诊断策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于一家三级医疗机构,并依赖存档菌株,这可能影响其普遍适用性。由于研究集中在特定地理区域并使用历史数据,证据强度中等。

analysis.time: 2024-2025, with surveillance findings suggesting a possible transition toward endemic status as of November 8, 2026.
analysis.event: Mpox continued to circulate at low levels in the United States during 2024 and 2025, with surveillance findings suggesting a possible transition toward endemic status. The article also mentions HPV vaccination rates remaining stalled among U.S. adolescents in 2025.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Mpox transmission persisted at low levels, but vaccination was linked to lower hospitalization risk. HPV vaccination coverage among U.S. adolescents remained largely unchanged for a fourth consecutive year in 2025.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The article discusses ongoing surveillance and the role of vaccination in reducing hospitalization risk. It does not provide specific details on the investigation, testing, or isolation measures taken.

analysis.brief_en: The article reports that mpox continued to circulate at low levels in the United States during 2024 and 2025, with surveillance findings indicating a possible transition toward endemic status. It highlights that vaccination is associated with a lower risk of hospitalization. Additionally, the piece notes that HPV vaccination rates among U.S. adolescents remained largely unchanged for a fourth consecutive year in 2025. The focus is on the ongoing transmission of mpox and the impact of vaccination on its health outcomes. The article does not provide specific details on the investigation, testing, or isolation measures taken, but it underscores the importance of monitoring and vaccination efforts in managing the disease. The findings are based on surveillance data and are not accompanied by hard exclusions or terminal entities.

news.source_body_en: The article reports that mpox continued to circulate at low levels in the United States during 2024 and 2025, with surveillance findings indicating a possible transition toward endemic status. It highlights that vaccination is associated with a lower risk of hospitalization. Additionally, the piece notes that HPV vaccination rates among U.S. adolescents remained largely unchanged for a fourth consecutive year in 2025. The focus is on the ongoing transmission of mpox and the impact of vaccination on its health outcomes. The article does not provide specific details on the investigation, testing, or isolation measures taken, but it underscores the importance of monitoring and vaccination efforts in managing the disease. The findings are based on surveillance data and are not accompanied by hard exclusions or terminal entities.
news.content_zh: 文章报告称,2024年和2025年期间,猴痘在美国持续在低水平传播,监测的研究结果表明可能正向地方性转变。文章强调疫苗接种与较低住院风险相关。此外,文中指出2025年美国青少年中HPV 疫苗接种的感染率继续保持不变,这是连续第四年。文章的重点是猴痘的持续传播以及疫苗接种对其健康结果的影响。文章未提供关于调查、检测或隔离措施的具体细节,但强调了监测和疫苗接种工作在管理该疾病中的重要性。研究结果基于监测的数据,并未伴随明确排除或终末实体。

news.wechat_summary_zh: 时间：2024-2025，监测的研究结果表明可能正向地方性转变，截至2026年11月8日。；地点与对象：美国，青少年。；事件：2024年和2025年期间，猴痘在美国持续在低水平传播，监测的研究结果表明可能正向地方性转变。文章还提到2025年美国青少年中HPV 疫苗接种的感染率继续保持不变。；影响与风险：猴痘的传播持续在低水平，但疫苗接种与较低住院风险相关。2025年，美国青少年中HPV 疫苗接种的覆盖率继续保持不变。；应对与不确定性：文章讨论了监测的持续情况以及疫苗接种在降低住院风险中的作用。文章未提供关于调查、检测或隔离措施的具体细节。

news.content_title: New outbreak of mpox in Anchorage prompts advisory from state health officials
news.content: A colorized electron micrograph image shows mpox virus particles, in red and yellow, found within infected cells, colored blue. The virus particles are in various stages of maturity, which accounts for differences in shape. The image also features virus factories, shown in brown, where viruses replicate, mature and assemble. (Image provided by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases/National Institutes of Health) A rare viral disease has emerged in an outbreak in Alaska's largest city that appears to be expanding, state health officials report. There are now four new cases in Anchorage of mpox , a viral disease formerly called monkeypox that is spread through close contact and can be fatal. None of the patients reported traveling outside the state in month-long period before becoming infected. It is the highest number of annual mpox cases in Alaska since 2022, when five cases were diagnosed in the state amid a global outbreak . Between 2023 and 2025, there were only two Alaska cases. Three of the Anchorage cases emerged in October and were reported last week through a state Department of Health alert intended to raise awareness in the public and among healthcare providers. The fourth case was reported to state officials on Thursday, said Dr. Joe McLaughlin, Alaska's state epidemiologist. SUBSCRIBE: GET THE MORNING HEADLINES DELIVERED TO YOUR INBOX. The four Anchorage cases are among men who reported no travel outside of Alaska in the past 30 days, Mclaughlin said. That is a contrast with the previous Alaska cases, all of which were among people who had recent travel experiences. Up to now, travel had been implicated in the spread of mpox in Alaska. Officials are currently trying to track the source of infection, said McLaughlin and Dr. Randi Rollins, a U.S. Centers for Disease Control epidemiologist working with the Alaska Department of Health. The lack of reported out-of-state travel "does not necessarily establish that the monkeypox virus is circulating here in Alaska," Rollins said. "They may have had exposure to somebody who traveled to Alaska, and they may be the end of that transmission line at this point. We don't know." Mpox is characterized by lesions that appear on various parts of the body. It usually takes three to 17 days after infection for symptoms to emerge, Rollins said, and in the first phase, the symptoms are flu-like: "fever, chills, fatigue, headache, sore muscles, and even swollen lymph nodes." The lesions develop in the second phase, with bumps that are firm to the touch or sometimes tender, she said. Some people skip the early symptoms and do not have any signs of infection until the rash phase develops, she said. The sickness lasts a few weeks, and patients are considered to have recovered when all the lesions are gone. Until that last lesion is completely healed, "the person is still infectious and can transmit monkeypox, and that can typically take two to four weeks," she said. McLaughlin said the Alaska patients are isolating and recovering. Two of the reported cases were among men who are partners, but it is unknown whether there are any additional links between any of the patients, he said. The new outbreak of mpox in Anchorage fits a national pattern. After a lull that followed the 2022-23 global outbreak, cases are on the rise again in the United States. An uptick in infections started in March, the CDC reported. The virus circulating now is genetically different from the variety behind the global outbreak in 2022, which is called clade II. The currently circulating virus is called clade I. In Central Africa, the clade I variation had been more deadly than the clade II variation. But the current variation of the clade I virus appears to be not particularly deadly, according to health officials. Spread of the virus happens through close contact, including but not limited to sexual contact. A vial containing the mpox vaccine is seen on July 23, 2022, in London, England. This type of vaccine, called JYNNEOS or Imvanex, is available in Alaska for anyone considered to be at elevated risk, including people who have been in contact with infected individuals. (Photo by Hollie Adams/Getty Images) Alaska health officials are encouraging anyone considered to be at risk of infection to get vaccinated. The JYNNEOS vaccine , approved by the Food and Drug Administration in 2019, guards against both clades of mpox, as well as smallpox, a disease that historically killed much of the world's population but is now considered to have been eradicated. The vaccine, which is administered in two doses, is available through the Anchorage Health Department and other health providers. It is recommended for certain groups of people considered to be at higher risk for infections. Those include men who have sex with other men, anyone with exposure to another person suspected of having mpox, people who are traveling to parts of the world with mpox outbreaks and medical workers, such as those employed in labs or healthcare facilities, whose jobs put them at risk of being exposed to this and other pathogens. The vaccine is effective even for people already infected with the virus, reducing risks even for those who might develop the disease, Rollins said. For anyone who has been exposed, "it's recommended that you get that vaccine within 4 days of exposure," she said. While that time window is ideal, "you can get it up to about 14 days and still see effectiveness at reducing disease severity," she said. State immunization records show that since 2022, 851 people in Alaska have received a first dose of the JYNNEOS vaccine and 604 receiving a second dose, Rollins said. While healthcare providers are being advised to watch for the resurgence of mpox, there is news about a rarer type of pox disease: borealpox. Two cases of borealpox , formerly known as Alaskapox, have been diagnosed this year, Rollins and McLaughlin said. That brings the world's total number of diagnosed borealpox cases to nine. The disease, related to mpox, smallpox and other poxes, was first identified in 2015 in Fairbanks. The first six cases were found in Fairbanks and were considered to be mild. Like other pox diseases, they were characterized by skin lesions and some flu-like symptoms. However, in January of 2024, a Kenai Peninsula man died from borealpox after being infected by what scientists discovered was a genetically different strain of the virus. The patient was in his 60s and had an immune system weakened by treatment for cancer. This year's two borealpox cases, like the previous Fairbanks-area cases, were mild, Rollins said. "It was the lesion that came to the attention of both patients, and they sought treatment for the lesion," she said. "One patient did experience respiratory illness, fever, muscle aches, joint aches." Scientists say borealpox circulates among small mammals . So far, red-backed voles, which are plentiful across most of Alaska, have been identified as a major reservoir. Investigation of cases so far has focused on household pets that appear to have encountered infected voles or other small mammals. Unlike the case with mpox, there is no vaccine for borealpox. But some scientists are working on developing one, and some are investigating the effectiveness of certain antiviral medicines to treat infections. elements_en.event: It usually takes three to 17 days after infection for symptoms to emerge, Rollins said, and in the first phase, the symptoms are flu-like: "fever, chills, fatigue, headache, sore muscles, and even swollen lymph nodes." The lesions develop in the second phase, with bumps that are firm to the touch or sometimes tender, she said.
elements_en.scale_impact_and_risk: The JYNNEOS vaccine , approved by the Food and Drug Administration in 2019, guards against both clades of mpox, as well as smallpox, a disease that historically killed much of the world's population but is now considered to have been eradicated.
elements_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: Investigation of cases so far has focused on household pets that appear to have encountered infected voles or other small mammals.

news.title_zh: 安克雷奇出现新的暴发病毒引发州卫生官员警告
news.source_body_en: A colorized electron micrograph image shows mpox virus particles, in red and yellow, found within infected cells, colored blue. The virus particles are in various stages of maturity, which accounts for differences in shape. The image also features virus factories, shown in brown, where viruses replicate, mature and assemble. (Image provided by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases/National Institutes of Health) A rare viral disease has emerged in an outbreak in Alaska's largest city that appears to be expanding, state health officials report. There are now four new cases in Anchorage of mpox , a viral disease formerly called monkeypox that is spread through close contact and can be fatal. None of the patients reported traveling outside the state in month-long period before becoming infected. It is the highest number of annual mpox cases in Alaska since 2022, when five cases were diagnosed in the state amid a global outbreak .
news.content_zh: 一张彩色电子显微镜图像显示了猴痘病毒病毒颗粒,红色和黄色,位于被感染的细胞中,细胞被染成蓝色。这些病毒颗粒处于不同的成熟阶段,这导致了它们形状上的差异。图像还展示了病毒工厂,呈棕色,病毒在这些地方复制、成熟并组装。(图片由国家过敏和传染病研究所/美国国立卫生研究院提供)州卫生官员报告称,一种罕见的病毒感染已在阿拉斯加最大城市安克雷奇出现,并似乎正在扩散。目前,安克雷奇已确诊四例猴痘病毒感染,这是一种以前被称为猴痘的病毒性疾病,通过密切接触传播,可能导致死亡。没有患者报告在感染前的一个月内曾前往州外旅行。这是自2022年以来阿拉斯加年度猴痘病例数最高的一年,2022年阿拉斯加在猴痘全球暴发期间确诊了五例病例。
